verdict.rationale: Mercury's docs explicitly direct AI agents to https://docs.mercury.com/llms.txt, an index of all pages in Markdown, and say any docs page URL can take a .md suffix. A live probe confirmed llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with that content, and Mercury also publishes official SKILL.md agent skills. Missing for 10: a publicly downloadable OpenAPI spec (conventional spec paths 404 and ReadMe hides the download, despite llms.txt promising endpoints in OpenAPI), and independent hands-on reports of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: For AI agents: visit https://docs.mercury.com/llms.txt for an index of all pages formatted in Markdown and endpoints in OpenAPI. Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version.
